DESIGN_SHA = "7496adf6cd9825f8e1dcdafeaa7b84ddea54a6229296502ad46b4d662272486b"
HEAD = "556c4fe1c5b28db54496a11133f5c7ec9ae79e98"
SOURCE = "2026-09-15-one-step-intervention-projection-corrected-design"
HYPOTHESES = ("HH", "HF")
ACTIONS = ("a0", "aH", "aF", "aHF")


def canonical(value):
    return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"),
                      ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")


def digest_bytes(value):
    return hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()


def digest(value):
    return digest_bytes(canonical(value))


def dump_model(value):
    return value.model_dump(mode="json", warnings=False)


def frac(value):
    return Fraction(str(value))


def fstr(value):
    value = Fraction(value)
    return str(value.numerator) if value.denominator == 1 else f"{value.numerator}/{value.denominator}"


def interval(lo, hi=None):
    hi = lo if hi is None else hi
    return {"lower": fstr(lo), "lower_closed": True,
            "upper": fstr(hi), "upper_closed": True, "unit": "degC"}


def premise(premise_id, value, *, edition=1, availability="present",
            epistemic_kind="synthetic_assumption", scope="one_step_enclosure"):
    body = {"applicability_scope": scope, "availability": availability,
            "edition": edition, "epistemic_kind": epistemic_kind,
            "premise_id": premise_id, "source": SOURCE, "value": value}
    body["payload_sha256"] = digest(body)
    return body


def refinalize(value):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        for item in value.values():
            refinalize(item)
        if "premise_id" in value and "payload_sha256" in value:
            payload = {k: v for k, v in value.items() if k != "payload_sha256"}
            value["payload_sha256"] = digest(payload)
    elif isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
        for item in value:
            refinalize(item)


def public_bundle(loaded, *, extra_query=None, variant):
    records = tuple(sorted(loaded.records.values(), key=lambda item: item.record_id))
    material = kernel.ModelQueryMaterial(revision=loaded.revision, records=records)
    queries = kernel.ModelQueries(loaded)
    state_registration = next(x for x in records if x.record_kind == "state_registration")
    state_declaration = next(x for x in records if x.record_kind == "state_declaration")
    constraint_registration = next(x for x in records if x.record_kind == "constraint_registration")
    variable_registration = next(x for x in records if x.record_kind == "variable_registration"
                                 and x.anchor.display_name == "Hotend temperature")
    results = {
        "constraint_declaration": dump_model(queries.constraint_declaration(
            constraint_registration.anchor.anchor_id)),
        "state_declaration": dump_model(queries.state_declaration(
            state_registration.anchor.anchor_id, context=state_declaration.context)),
        "variable": dump_model(queries.variable(variable_registration.anchor.anchor_id)),
    }
    if extra_query is not None:
        results["independent_lamp"] = dump_model(queries.entity(extra_query))
    return {
        "bindings": {"D-HOT": state_registration.anchor.anchor_id,
                     "T": variable_registration.anchor.anchor_id,
                     "hot_constraint": constraint_registration.anchor.anchor_id,
                     "pinned_vcn": state_declaration.conditions[0].constraint_declaration_record_id},
        "kind": "complete_public_query_bundle",
        "material": dump_model(material),
        "producer_receipt": {"calls": sorted(results),
                             "implementation": "backend.model_kernel.ModelQueries",
                             "validation": "public constructors and owning results",
                             "variant": variant},
        "results": results,
    }


def build_public_objects(repo):
    loaded = kernel.ModelStore(repo / "models/demo-printer").load()
    authority = kernel.AuthorityRef(kind="test_fixture",
                                    agent="intervention_projection_preparation",
                                    method="manual_declaration")
    lamp = build_record(
        kernel.EntityRegistration,
        anchor=EntityAnchor(anchor_id="ent_" + "1" * 32,
                            namespace="intervention-proof",
                            display_name="Independent lamp",
                            referent_kind="physical_instance"),
        recorded_at=datetime(2026, 9, 15, 12, 0, tzinfo=UTC),
        authority=authority, note="synthetic independent lamp")
    lamp_records = dict(loaded.records)
    lamp_records[lamp.record_id] = lamp
    lamp_loaded = validate_record_collection(loaded.revision.model_id, lamp_records)

    old_vcn = next(x for x in loaded.records.values()
                   if x.record_kind == "variable_constraint_declaration")
    fields = old_vcn.model_dump(mode="python")
    fields.pop("record_id")
    fields.pop("schema_version")
    fields["supersedes"] = (old_vcn.record_id,)
    fields["recorded_at"] = datetime(2026, 9, 15, 12, 1, tzinfo=UTC)
    fields["note"] = "synthetic successor for stale-pin dependency review"
    successor = build_record(kernel.VariableConstraintDeclaration, **fields)
    successor_records = dict(loaded.records)
    successor_records[successor.record_id] = successor
    successor_loaded = validate_record_collection(loaded.revision.model_id,
                                                  successor_records)
    return {
        "base": public_bundle(loaded, variant="base"),
        "lamp": public_bundle(lamp_loaded, extra_query=lamp.anchor.anchor_id,
                              variant="independent_lamp_append"),
        "vcn": public_bundle(successor_loaded, variant="vcn_successor_append"),
    }

def set_premise_status(item, status, *, edition=None):
    item["availability"] = status
    if edition is not None:
        item["edition"] = edition
    if status == "missing":
        item["value"] = None
    elif status == "unknown":
        item["value"] = {"basis": "support_not_supplied", "status": "unknown"}

def action_refs(world, action):
    return world["actions"]["value"][action]


def premise_by_ref(world, family, reference):
    name, edition = reference.rsplit("@", 1)
    item = world[family][name]
    return item, int(edition)


def gate_row(world, action):
    app = world["applicability"]["value"]["status"]
    if app == "false":
        return "inapplicable", "applicability_false", "/application_world/applicability/value/status"
    if app != "true":
        return "unknown", "applicability_unknown", "/application_world/applicability/value/status"
    spec = action_refs(world, action)
    for reference in spec.get("effect_refs", []):
        item, expected = premise_by_ref(world, "effects", reference)
        if item["edition"] != expected:
            return "refused", "effect_edition_mismatch", f"/application_world/effects/{item['premise_id']}/edition"
        if item["availability"] != "present":
            return "unknown", "effect_missing", f"/application_world/effects/{item['premise_id']}/availability"
    for reference in spec.get("precondition_refs", []):
        item, expected = premise_by_ref(world, "preconditions", reference)
        if item["edition"] != expected:
            return "refused", "premise_edition_mismatch", f"/application_world/preconditions/{item['premise_id']}/edition"
        status = None if item["value"] is None else item["value"].get("status")
        if item["availability"] != "present" or status == "unknown":
            return "unknown", "precondition_unknown", f"/application_world/preconditions/{item['premise_id']}"
        if status == "false":
            return "inapplicable", "precondition_false", f"/application_world/preconditions/{item['premise_id']}/value/status"
    for reference in spec.get("timing_refs", []):
        item, expected = premise_by_ref(world, "timing", reference)
        if item["edition"] != expected:
            return "refused", "premise_edition_mismatch", f"/application_world/timing/{item['premise_id']}/edition"
        if item["availability"] != "present" or item["value"].get("status") != "true":
            return "unknown", "timing_unknown", f"/application_world/timing/{item['premise_id']}"
    for reference in spec.get("invariance_refs", []):
        item, expected = premise_by_ref(world, "invariants", reference)
        if item["edition"] != expected:
            return "refused", "premise_edition_mismatch", f"/application_world/invariants/{item['premise_id']}/edition"
        if item["availability"] != "present" or item["value"].get("status") != "true":
            return "unknown", "invariance_unknown", f"/application_world/invariants/{item['premise_id']}"
    beta = world["uncertainty"]["value"]["beta"]
    if beta["availability"] != "present" or beta["support"] is None:
        return "unknown", "uncertainty_support_missing", "/application_world/uncertainty/value/beta"
    return "ready", None, None


def project_raw(world):
    rows = []
    any_refusal = None
    for hypothesis in HYPOTHESES:
        for action in ACTIONS:
            status, code, target = gate_row(world, action)
            decision_id = f"D-RAW-{hypothesis}-{action}"
            if status == "refused":
                any_refusal = {"code": code, "premise_ids": ["E-aH"], "stage": 7,
                               "target": target}
                continue
            if status != "ready":
                rows.append({"decision_id": decision_id, "diagnostics": [{"code": code,
                    "premise_ids": [], "target": target}], "effect_sources": [],
                    "hypothesis_id": hypothesis, "outcome": None, "status": status,
                    "trace": {"arithmetic_performed": False, "stopped_at": code}})
                continue
            commands = world["commands"]["value"]
            if hypothesis == "HH":
                h, f = Fraction(1), frac(commands["u_f"])
            else:
                h, f = frac(commands["u_h"]), Fraction(0)
            pre = {"f": fstr(f), "h": fstr(h)}
            effect_sources = []
            for reference in action_refs(world, action).get("effect_refs", []):
                name = reference.split("@", 1)[0]
                effect_sources.append(reference)
                for key, value in world["effects"][name]["value"]["assignments"].items():
                    if key == "h": h = frac(value)
                    if key == "f": f = frac(value)
            state = world["state"]["value"]
            params = world["parameters"]["value"]
            beta_support = world["uncertainty"]["value"]["beta"]["support"]
            beta_values = sorted({frac(beta_support["lower"]), frac(beta_support["upper"])})
            values = []
            corners = []
            for beta in beta_values:
                out = (frac(state["T0"]) + frac(params["alpha"]) * h
                       - frac(params["gamma"]) * f
                       - beta * (frac(state["T0"]) - frac(state["A"])))
                values.append(out)
                corners.append({"beta": fstr(beta), "T1": fstr(out)})
            result_interval = interval(min(values), max(values))
            rows.append({"decision_id": decision_id, "diagnostics": [],
                         "effect_sources": effect_sources,
                         "hypothesis_id": hypothesis, "outcome": result_interval,
                         "status": "ready", "trace": {
                             "arithmetic_performed": True,
                             "corner_evaluations": corners,
                             "equation": world["law"]["value"]["equation"],
                             "hypothesis_mapping": pre,
                             "post_effect_inputs": {"f": fstr(f), "h": fstr(h)},
                             "shared_beta_coordinate": True,
                             "stage_order": ["hypothesis", "effect", "law_once"]}})
    return any_refusal, rows


def relation(raw, target):
    rlo, rhi = frac(raw["lower"]), frac(raw["upper"])
    tlo, thi = frac(target["lower"]), frac(target["upper"])
    if tlo <= rlo and rhi <= thi:
        return "guaranteed"
    if rhi < tlo or thi < rlo:
        return "incompatible"
    return "possible_not_guaranteed"


def policy_results(world, raw_rows):
    raw_by = {row["decision_id"]: row for row in raw_rows}
    target_value = world["target"]["value"]["interval"]
    target_rows = []
    for h in HYPOTHESES:
        for a in ACTIONS:
            raw = raw_by[f"D-RAW-{h}-{a}"]
            rel = relation(raw["outcome"], target_value) if raw["status"] == "ready" else None
            target_rows.append({"decision_id": f"D-TGT-{h}-{a}",
                "diagnostics": raw["diagnostics"], "hypothesis_id": h,
                "raw_decision_id": raw["decision_id"], "raw_outcome": raw["outcome"],
                "relation": rel, "status": raw["status"], "target": target_value,
                "trace": {"closed_endpoints": True,
                          "operation": "subset_then_intersection" if rel else "not_performed"}})
    target_by = {row["decision_id"]: row for row in target_rows}
    retained = world["retained_hypotheses"]["value"]["ids"]
    feasibility = []
    for a in ACTIONS:
        contributing = [target_by[f"D-TGT-{h}-{a}"] for h in retained]
        statuses = [row["status"] for row in contributing]
        relations = [row["relation"] for row in contributing]
        if "inapplicable" in statuses: value = "inapplicable"
        elif "unknown" in statuses: value = "unknown"
        elif all(x == "guaranteed" for x in relations): value = "guaranteed"
        elif any(x == "incompatible" for x in relations): value = "incompatible"
        else: value = "possible_not_guaranteed"
        feasibility.append({"action_id": a, "contributors": [x["decision_id"] for x in contributing],
                            "decision_id": f"D-FEAS-{a}", "status": value,
                            "trace": {"policy": "robust_across_retained", "retained": retained}})
    if world["applicability"]["value"]["status"] == "false":
        selection = {"decision_id": "D-SELECT", "minimum_cost": None,
                     "scope": ACTIONS, "selected": [],
                     "status": "inapplicable_for_declared_model", "trace": []}
    elif any(x["status"] == "unknown" for x in feasibility):
        selection = {"decision_id": "D-SELECT", "minimum_cost": None,
                     "scope": ACTIONS, "selected": [], "status": "unknown",
                     "trace": [dict(action_id=x["action_id"], feasibility=x["status"])
                               for x in feasibility]}
    else:
        feasible = [x["action_id"] for x in feasibility if x["status"] == "guaranteed"]
        costs = world["costs"]["value"]
        if not feasible:
            selection = {"decision_id": "D-SELECT", "minimum_cost": None,
                         "scope": ACTIONS, "selected": [],
                         "status": "no_feasible_action_in_supplied_set",
                         "trace": [dict(action_id=x["action_id"], feasibility=x["status"])
                                   for x in feasibility]}
        else:
            minimum = min(frac(costs[a]) for a in feasible)
            selected = sorted(a for a in feasible if frac(costs[a]) == minimum)
            selection = {"decision_id": "D-SELECT", "minimum_cost": fstr(minimum),
                         "scope": ACTIONS, "selected": selected,
                         "status": "selected_from_supplied_set",
                         "trace": [dict(action_id=a, cost=costs[a]) for a in sorted(feasible)]}
    return target_rows, feasibility, selection


def projection_response(world):
    refusal, raw = project_raw(world)
    if refusal:
        return {"diagnostics": [refusal], "operation": "one_step_projection",
                "operation_status": "refused", "provenance": {
                    "classification": "expected_by_independent_oracle",
                    "physical_execution": "not_established"}, "result": None,
                "version": 1}
    target, feasibility, selection = policy_results(world, raw)
    observations = world["observations"]["value"]["items"]
    return {"diagnostics": [], "operation": "one_step_projection",
            "operation_status": "complete", "provenance": {
                "calculation": "calculated_from_synthetic_assumptions",
                "observations_carried_not_used": len(observations),
                "physical_execution": "not_established"},

def diff_paths(before, after, prefix=""):
    if isinstance(before, dict) and isinstance(after, dict):
        out = []
        for key in sorted(set(before) | set(after)):
            if key in {"payload_sha256", "source", "world_id", "world_edition",
                       "public_material_commitment"}:
                continue
            path = prefix + "/" + key
            if key not in before or key not in after:
                out.append(path)
            else:
                out.extend(diff_paths(before[key], after[key], path))
        return out
    if before != after:
        return [prefix]
    return []


def invalid_effect_reference(world):

        for reference in action_refs(world, action).get("effect_refs", []):
            name, edition = reference.rsplit("@", 1)
            if name not in world["effects"] or world["effects"][name]["edition"] != int(edition):
                return {"code": "effect_edition_mismatch", "premise_ids": [name], "stage": 7,
                        "target": f"/proposed_application_world/effects/{name}/edition"}
    return None


def review_set(before, after, before_public, after_public):
    stale = invalid_effect_reference(after)
    if stale:
        return stale, [], diff_paths(before, after, "/application")
    changed = diff_paths(before, after, "/application")
    changed_public = []
    before_records = {x["record_id"]: x for x in before_public["material"]["records"]}
    for record in after_public["material"]["records"]:
        if record["record_id"] not in before_records:
            changed_public.append(f"/public/records/{record['record_id']}")
            if (record["record_kind"] == "variable_constraint_declaration"
                    and before_public["bindings"]["pinned_vcn"] in record.get("supersedes", [])):
                changed_public.append("/public/currentness/pinned_vcn")
    changed.extend(changed_public)
    raw = set(); target = set(); feas = set(); selected = False; hot = False
    for path in changed:
        if path == "/public/currentness/pinned_vcn": hot = True
        if any(x in path for x in ("/parameters/", "/law/", "/uncertainty/", "/applicability/")):
            raw.update((h, a) for h in HYPOTHESES for a in ACTIONS)
        for token, affected in (("/effects/E-aH/", ("aH", "aHF")),
                                ("/timing/T-aH/", ("aH", "aHF")),
                                ("/preconditions/PC-isolation/", ("aH", "aHF")),
                                ("/invariants/I-aH/", ("aH", "aHF"))):
            if token in path:
                raw.update((h, a) for h in HYPOTHESES for a in affected)
        if "/target/" in path:
            target.update((h, a) for h in HYPOTHESES for a in ACTIONS)
        if "/costs/" in path or "/selection_policy/" in path:
            selected = True
    target.update(raw)
    for h, a in target:
        if h == "HH": feas.add(a)
    if feas: selected = True
    ids = ({"D-HOT"} if hot else set())
    ids.update(f"D-RAW-{h}-{a}" for h, a in raw)
    ids.update(f"D-TGT-{h}-{a}" for h, a in target)
    ids.update(f"D-FEAS-{a}" for a in feas)
    if selected: ids.add("D-SELECT")
    return None, sorted(ids), sorted(changed)


def semantic_map(projection, *, hot="current"):
    result = {"D-HOT": {"status": hot}}
    if projection["operation_status"] == "refused":
        return result
    p = projection["result"]
    for row in p["raw_predictions"]:
        result[row["decision_id"]] = {"outcome": row["outcome"], "status": row["status"]}
    for row in p["target_assessments"]:
        result[row["decision_id"]] = {"relation": row["relation"], "status": row["status"]}
    for row in p["feasibility"]:
        result[row["decision_id"]] = {"status": row["status"]}
    result["D-SELECT"] = {"minimum_cost": p["selection"]["minimum_cost"],
                          "selected": p["selection"]["selected"],
                          "status": p["selection"]["status"]}
    return result

                "operation": "dependency_review", "operation_status": "refused",

    before_sem = semantic_map(before_projection)
    after_hot = "requires_requery_pinned_vcn_not_current" if "D-HOT" in reevaluate else "current"
    after_sem = semantic_map(after_projection, hot=after_hot)

def node_metrics(value, depth=1):
    nodes = 1
    maximum = depth
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        for item in value.values():
            n, d = node_metrics(item, depth + 1); nodes += n; maximum = max(maximum, d)
    elif isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
        for item in value:
            n, d = node_metrics(item, depth + 1); nodes += n; maximum = max(maximum, d)
    return nodes, maximum


def resolve(value, objects, seen=None):
    seen = set() if seen is None else seen
    if isinstance(value, dict) and set(value) == {"$ref"}:
        key = value["$ref"]
        if key in seen: raise ValueError("reference cycle")
        return resolve(copy.deepcopy(objects[key]["value"]), objects, seen | {key})
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {k: resolve(v, objects, seen) for k, v in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
        return [resolve(v, objects, seen) for v in value]
    return value


def ref_count(value):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return (1 if set(value) == {"$ref"} else
                sum(ref_count(x) for x in value.values()))
    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)): return sum(ref_count(x) for x in value)
    return 0


def premise_count(value):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return (1 if "premise_id" in value else 0) + sum(premise_count(x) for x in value.values())
    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)): return sum(premise_count(x) for x in value)
    return 0


def trace_count(value, parent=None):
    count = 0
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        for key, item in value.items():
            if key in {"corner_evaluations", "contributors", "trace"}:
                count += len(item) if isinstance(item, list) else 1
            count += trace_count(item, key)
    elif isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
        count += sum(trace_count(x, parent) for x in value)
    return count


def metrics(value, objects=None):
    wire = canonical(value); wn, wd = node_metrics(value)
    result = {"wire_bytes": len(wire), "wire_depth": wd, "wire_nodes": wn,
              "references": ref_count(value)}
    if objects is not None:
        expanded = resolve(value, objects); rb = canonical(expanded); rn, rd = node_metrics(expanded)
        result.update({"premises": premise_count(expanded), "resolved_bytes": len(rb),
                       "resolved_depth": rd, "resolved_nodes": rn,
                       "resolution_charge_nodes": rn - wn + result["references"]})
        return result
    return {"output_bytes": len(wire), "output_depth": wd,
            "output_nodes": wn, "trace_rows": trace_count(value)}
